title: bulkMAE 0.4.0
text: Replaces mixed run_*, infer_*, prepare_*, backend-specific naming discoverable <family>_<method>() / <family>_<operation>() APIs. Organizes public functions mae_*, qc_*, reduce_*, de_*, enrich_*, score_*, activity_*, cluster_*, coexpr_*, network_*, deconv_*, surv_*, ml_*, meta_*, drug_* families. Consolidates GO, KEGG, Reactome ORA/GSEA combinations behind explicit method arguments instead multiplying function names. Removes old exported aliases intentionally autocomplete exposes one coherent API; installed migration map records every breaking rename. Restores compatibility across declared R 4.4+ dependency range, including edgeR tximport/differential-splicing fallbacks, current dream moderation, timeROC namespace resolution, decoupleR method-argument conventions, namespace-NMF, WGCNA, MuSiC, immunedeconv execution. Adds explicit MAE assay/feature helpers direct TPM normalization gene lengths stored rowData, aligned assay, supplied vector/matrix. Completes simulated-data suite spanning 84 public functions, including real offline xCell, MuSiC, BayesPrism, NMF, WGCNA, GO, Reactome backend smoke tests without requiring network services. Keeps network-backed tests disabled default. Set BULKMAE_RUN_ONLINE_TESTS=true deliberately testing remote resources.

title: bulkMAE 0.3.0
text: Enforces name-aware sample, design, feature, annotation alignment across stateless adapters, early failures missing covariates aliased fixed-effect designs. Completes edgeR quasi-likelihood workflow dispersion estimation repairs logical-vector handling goseq. Strengthens maSigPro, differential-splicing, DCA, consensus clustering, WGCNA, module-preservation, embedding, activity, clinical, deconvolution input contracts. Keeps WGCNA’s automatic bad-sample/bad-gene filtering reporting retaining quality decision native result list. Localizes wrapper-controlled random seeds calls mutate user’s global random-number stream. Adds executable local examples, conditional backend tests, installed audit guides, package-level help needed standard source build.

title: bulkMAE 0.2.0

Adds consensus-clustering diagnostics, differential co-expression, WGCNA module preservation. Adds continuous-expression limma, differential splicing, maSigPro time-course modelling. Adds UMAP/t-SNE, limma batch removal, Kaplan-Meier, time-dependent ROC. Expands tutorial official-source audit map every new adapter.

title: bulkMAE 0.1.0
